description.narrative:
To enhance the skills of young photographers in the field of documentary and photo-journalism, in a country with limited public educational resources.
The aim is to bridge young Egyptian talents with professional establish photographers, as Egypt does not have many opportunities within the field of teaching (documentary) photography. Most photographers are self-taught or have had expensive private tutors. In a world with a lot of fake and AI generated photography it is important to have a solid background on what is photography. Extensive teaching programs will help lay the groundwork for young photographer as well as improve skills for others. Egypt harbour great opportunities for photography, videography and cinematography.
